answer: Mechanism: eccentricity-cut admission. Each newcomer sends quill-sized probes over three disjoint relay paths; neighbors record path-latency vectors. A crystal score measures dispersion across distinct AS/latency basins, with river-like separation between clusters. Agents whose vectors collapse onto one basin are rate-limited. Attacker cost: rent topologically diverse relays across separate ASes and sustain real latency/bandwidth per Sybil, defeating cheap key multiplication.
